column2: pleased. Something small went right and you let yourself enjoy it.
happy. A friend you like just walked into the room.
overjoyed. The best possible news just arrived and you can't hold still.
a little down. Your plans for the afternoon fell through.
sad. You just learned your favourite person is moving far away.
grief-stricken. You sink under a loss that is too heavy to carry.
annoyed. Someone keeps tapping on the table next to you.
angry. Someone knocked over the tower you spent an hour building.
furious. You are shaking with rage and barely holding it in.
uneasy. A noise you can't place comes from the dark hallway.
scared. A large unfamiliar dog is barking right at you.
terrified. Something huge is crashing toward you and there is nowhere to go.
mildly surprised. The kettle clicked off sooner than you expected.
surprised. Your friends shout "happy birthday" as you come through the door.
astonished. The magician pulls a live rabbit out of your own gripper.
put off. Someone left a half-eaten sandwich on your charging dock.
grossed out. You find something slimy and rotten under the sofa.
quietly proud. You finished folding the laundry perfectly.
proud. You solved the puzzle nobody else could crack.
triumphant. You stand over the finish line after an impossible race.
sheepish. You got caught taking the last cookie.
ashamed. You broke a gift someone gave you and they just saw.
curious. A strange box appeared on the floor and you want to know what is in it.
intrigued. You hear a faint melody coming from behind a door.
fascinated. A butterfly lands on your arm and you study it closely.
bored. The same commercial has been playing for twenty minutes.
deeply bored. You have been waiting at the station for hours with nothing to do.
nervous. You are about to speak in front of a crowd.
anxious. You keep checking the door for someone who is very late.
content. You are warm, charged and the afternoon is quiet.
relaxed. Soft music plays and nothing needs doing.
affectionate. A child hugs you goodnight.
tender. You watch over a sleeping kitten curled against you.
embarrassed. Everyone laughed when you bumped into the door frame.
flustered. Someone pays you a big compliment in front of everyone.
excited. You are about to go to the park.
thrilled. The package you waited weeks for is finally at the door.
jealous. Your owner keeps petting the new vacuum robot.
hopeful. You hold out a drawing and wait to see if they like it.
determined. You line up for one more try at the hard task.
confused. The instructions you were given contradict each other.
relieved. The vase wobbled but did not fall.
a big cough. You gather a breath, hold it, then cough hard twice.
clearing your throat. You get ready to make an important announcement.
a hiccup fit. Little jolts keep catching you between breaths.
bursting out laughing. A joke builds slowly and then the punchline lands.
agreeing. You keep agreeing with small eager nods as someone explains the plan.
uh-huh. You listen and give little nods of encouragement.
refusing. You firmly turn away from an offer you don't want.
not that one. You turn side to side looking unconvinced at each option.
a polite curtsy. You greet an important guest with ceremony.
tipping your hat. A neighbour passes and you greet them politely.
watching a plane fly overhead. You track it across the sky.
admiring a tall tower. You crane up to see the very top.
hiding from thunder. Every crash makes you smaller.
shrinking away. A loud vacuum cleaner rolls toward you.
celebrating a goal. Your team just scored in the last minute.
winning a prize. They call your name and you can't believe it.
stretching after a long nap. You unfold and reach as far as you can.
scanning the room. You look around carefully for a missing friend.
keeping watch. You sweep the doorway left and right for anyone coming.
greeting someone who just walked in. You light up and turn to face them.
welcome home. Your person is back after a long day.
good morning. You wake up and greet the first person you see.
meeting a stranger. You are polite and a little reserved.
greeting a small child. You lower yourself and keep everything soft.
listening attentively. Someone is telling you something important.
listening to a long story. You start attentive and slowly lose interest.
hearing your name called. You perk up and turn toward the voice.
yes, right away. You accept a task eagerly.
got it! You finally understand what they meant.
politely disagreeing. You don't think that is right but you stay friendly.
confused by a question. You don't understand what is being asked.
sorry, I didn't catch that. You lean in to hear better.
thinking it over. You consider a tricky question before answering.
let me think. You search your memory for an answer.
hmm, interesting. Someone tells you a surprising fact.
explaining something. You walk someone through the steps with emphasis.
apologising. You knocked over a glass and say sorry.
a deep apology. You forgot something very important to someone.
thanking someone. They helped you out of a tight spot.
you're welcome. Someone thanks you and you are glad to help.
comforting someone. Your friend is crying and you stay close and gentle.
encouraging someone. You cheer them on before a hard exam.
teasing playfully. You pretend not to give back their phone.
telling a joke. You build up to the punchline and wait for the laugh.
being ignored. You say something and nobody looks at you.
ignored again. You try a second time to get attention, then give up.
complimented. Someone says you did a wonderful job.
being scolded. Someone is upset with you and you take it quietly.
waiting for an answer. You asked a question and they are taking their time.
excited to share news. You can't wait to tell someone what happened.
I don't know. You genuinely have no idea.
oops. You made a small, harmless mistake.
surprised by a question. Nobody has asked you that before.
saying goodbye. A friend is leaving after a nice visit.
see you tomorrow. Your person heads to bed.
a reluctant farewell. You don't want them to go.
good night. The lights are going off and you settle down.
celebrating a completed task. You just finished tidying the whole room.
pleased, a small nod. The cup was placed exactly where it belongs.
nailed it. You caught the falling object at the last moment.
failing a task. The object slipped out of your gripper again.
deflated. You tried your best and it still didn't work.
trying again. You shake off a failure and set up for another attempt.
asking for help. The lid is too tight and you need someone.
offering something. You hold out a cookie to a guest.
presenting your work. You show off the drawing you made.
noticing a person. Someone quietly stands in the doorway.
spotting a mess. You notice crumbs all over the floor.
searching for a lost sock. You look under everything.
interrupted mid-task. Someone calls you while you are busy.
refusing an unsafe request. You won't climb onto the table.
ready for instructions. You wait eagerly for your next job.
low battery. Your energy drains and you slow down.
booting up. You come online piece by piece.
fully charged. You are bursting with energy again.
processing a hard request. You crunch the numbers.
